result.title: Batched Speech Decisions Without Decoding: Single-Token Supervision Lets a Frozen LLM Hear Beyond the Transcript
result.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027. Code and weights: https://github.com/adventists-ai/duplexjev
result.summary: Full-duplex voice agents make many small, closed decisions, which current systems answer by slow autoregressive decoding. We propose DuplexJev, which feeds ASR-encoder hidden states through a small connector into a frozen LLM and reads each question as a single-token distribution over its options. Nothing is decoded, and an 8-GPU node answers 80 decisions about eight utterances in about 0.1 s. With a last-layer connector, spoken QA stays close to reading the transcript (90% vs. 91%). DuplexJev also hears the speaker: gender and emotion accuracy both reach 90% (from 55% and 28%) with a cross-attention connector, whose spoken QA drops by only 1 point (83% to 82%). We train decisions with cross-entropy on the read-out answer token, instead of the usual transcript distillation, whose teacher never hears the voice, and keep distillation for content. Encoders and LLMs are interchangeable; we release weights, training recipe, a batched-inference pipeline for full-duplex serving and a bilingual spoken-QA set.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 DuplexJev，将 ASR 编码器隐状态经小连接器注入冻结 LLM，用单 token 读出分布回答语音问答等封闭决策，避免自回归解码，并用读出答案 token 的交叉熵监督决策、对内容保留蒸馏。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「单 token 读出隐状态即得决策」与跨注意力连接器保留说话人属性，可能为 LVR 中 latent 内容是否被答案使用、以及视觉细节经旁路注入后如何监督提供可核查线索，但属语音模态，需进一步判断迁移性。
